question: What outcome follows from abstaining from food by day?
premises: Non-eating by day is specified as the means.
The future verb indicates a resulting state.
The object is death related to age.
inference: By abstaining from food during the day, one will go to the death of age.
uncertainties: The phrase vayo-mṛtyuṃ gamiṣyate is ambiguous and may mean overcoming death by age or undergoing it.
plain_english: By abstaining from food during the day, one will go to the death of age.
